title: Find your starting point
outcome: Choose the smallest prerequisite bridge that lets you explain a reproducible service.

title: Run the prerequisite fixture checks
outcome: Trace the supplied ingestion bridge without treating it as your completed earlier project.

title: Build once, run twice
outcome: Predict which values belong to an image and which belong to one running container.

title: Package the ingestion application
outcome: Write the build recipe and explain every path from host context to runtime import.

title: Let services find each other
outcome: Choose an address from the caller’s location and wire the five service boundaries.

title: Keep data through container replacement
outcome: Separate service startup, dependency readiness and persistent state.

title: Make health claims precise
outcome: Implement two endpoints whose status codes match the claims they make.

title: Write logs a tool can read
outcome: Create a safe JSON event and explain how it travels to a log reader.

title: Follow one request through middleware
outcome: Correlate successful and failed HTTP responses without leaking request content.

title: Diagnose the running stack
outcome: Find the failing layer with a probe, then prove the repair with a real job.

title: Make checks repeat on a clean runner
outcome: Write a push/PR workflow and explain each process and working directory.

title: Make the start path reproducible
outcome: Prove a documented start command without relying on hidden local files.

title: Prove ownership and retain it
outcome: Explain, debug and vary the stack independently, then schedule delayed retrieval.
